full_prompt_en: A square fantastical painting shows a sleeping child in an ornate golden headdress nestled within a dense, jewel-colored world of rounded aquatic forms. The background reaches every edge with layered blue-green, red, amber, and mossy shapes; there is almost no empty distance or conventional horizon. Near the center-left, the child's face tilts down toward the lower right, eyes closed and lips relaxed. Warm peach skin is modeled softly against cool blue shadows beneath the brow and cheek. Brown hair shows below a high curved headdress, whose overlapping plates are patterned with metallic gold, red insets, and fine incised lines. A thick ribbed gold collar circles the neck and catches a concentrated yellow glow. At the left and lower left, rich red and near-black fabric is covered with bright gold flecks, circular motifs, and granular embroidery-like texture. Immediately beside the face, a small round fish-like form with a bright eye emerges from the crowded color; further back, soft blue and coral-colored forms overlap in different directions. Across the bottom and right, clustered blossoms, tiny rounded shapes, dark teal fronds, and orange-red accents make a tapestry of short marks and sparkling points. The scene has painterly softness in the face and much denser stippling and patterned highlights in the surrounding surfaces. Warm luminous light seems to gather on the headdress, collar, cheek, and selected gold details, while cool turquoise shadows separate the layers behind them. Dark crevices between the clustered forms prevent the vivid colors from flattening into a single surface. The overall composition wraps the quiet sleeping face in an intricate circular flow of metallic warmth and deep aquatic color, creating a dreamlike, richly tactile mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形奇幻想象绘画呈现一名熟睡的孩童，戴着华丽的金色头饰，安卧在密集而如宝石般的水生圆润形体之间。背景层层蓝绿、红、琥珀和苔绿色形状一直延伸到画面四边，几乎没有空旷远景或传统地平线。中央偏左，孩童的脸向右下倾，双眼闭合，嘴唇放松。暖桃色皮肤柔和塑形，在眉下与脸颊的冷蓝阴影前显得明亮。棕发从高耸弯曲的头饰下露出，层叠片状结构布满金属金色、红色嵌块和细刻线。粗厚的金色棱纹领圈环住颈部，承接集中的黄色光泽。左侧和左下，浓红与近黑的织物布满明亮金色斑点、圆形纹样和刺绣般的颗粒肌理。脸旁，一团带明亮眼睛的小型圆鱼状形体从拥挤的色彩中浮出；后方柔软的蓝色与珊瑚色形体朝不同方向重叠。底部和右侧，簇拥的花、细小圆形、深青绿叶状物和橘红强调点构成由短笔触与闪光点组成的织锦。脸部具有绘画般的柔和感，周围表面则布满更密集的点状痕迹和纹样高光。温暖的发亮光感仿佛聚在头饰、领圈、脸颊及少量金色细节上，冷青绿阴影把后方层次分开。簇拥形体间的深暗缝隙阻止艳丽色彩塌成单一平面。整体构图以金属暖光和深水色的复杂环流包围安静的睡脸，形成梦境般、触感丰富的情绪。
style_prompt_en: This imaginative painterly finish combines softly blended focal planes with dense, granular ornament. Saturated turquoise, teal, scarlet, coral, amber, and antique gold overlap in closely packed layers, while pockets of near-black give the bright colors depth. Rounded arcs and small repeated dots establish a circulating rhythm; finely worked highlights are concentrated along selected ridges rather than spread evenly. Some edges melt into adjacent color and others sparkle with crisp gold flecks, creating a shifting boundary between softness and intricate texture. Light feels internally luminous and warm at the visual center, with cooler green-blue shadows receding around it. The image has little empty space, yet changes in scale, value, and texture keep the arrangement legible. The overall effect is immersive, ornate, and dreamlike.
style_prompt_zh: 这种富于想象的绘画完成面，把柔和调开的焦点平面与密集颗粒纹饰结合起来。饱和的青绿、蓝绿、绯红、珊瑚、琥珀和古金色在紧密层次中相互覆盖，近黑色的小块空隙为亮色提供纵深。圆弧与细小重复点建立环流般的节奏；精工高光只集中在部分隆起边缘，而非平均撒布。有些边缘融入邻近色彩，另一些则以清脆的金色斑点闪烁，在柔和与繁密肌理之间形成变动的边界。视觉中心的光感温暖，仿佛从内部发亮，四周较冷的绿蓝阴影则向后退。图中留白很少，但尺度、明度和纹理的变化仍使组织关系清楚。整体效果沉浸、华丽而梦幻。
theme_en: A sleeping child in a gold headdress among vivid aquatic forms
theme_zh: 戴金色头饰的沉睡孩童置身绚丽水生形体之间
name: Victor Nizovtsev
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
